nodes.label: Git for Musicians Analogy
nodes.author: SENAI — Sistemas de Inovação e Empreendedorismo
nodes.rationale: AMOTIF positions itself as a versioning system for audio projects — analogous to Git in software — filling the gap between local DAWs and generic file-sharing platforms by offering native tracking of versions, stems and millisecond-level layer offsets.

nodes.label: AMOTIF Mission
nodes.author: SENAI — Sistemas de Inovação e Empreendedorismo
nodes.rationale: Give musicians, producers and composers an intuitive yet technical platform to create, version and synchronize projects as a team, removing distance, format and tooling barriers.

nodes.label: SMART Objectives
nodes.author: SENAI — Sistemas de Inovação e Empreendedorismo
nodes.rationale: Four SMART goals: MVP beta launch by Dec 2025 with 500 signups in 30 days; 10,000 MAU by Dec 2026; R$ 50,000 MRR by Jun 2027 with 5% free-to-paid conversion; internationalization in English/Spanish across 3 LATAM and 2 European countries by Dec 2027.

nodes.label: Technical Precision with Artistic Sensitivity
nodes.author: SENAI — Sistemas de Inovação e Empreendedorismo
nodes.rationale: Milliseconds matter as much as melodies — technology in service of art without giving up rigor.

nodes.label: Corporate Values
nodes.author: SENAI — Sistemas de Inovação e Empreendedorismo
nodes.rationale: Six values: radical collaboration, openness and transparency, technical precision with artistic sensitivity, accessibility without borders, continuous iteration (versions and drafts as first-class citizens), and responsibility toward creators' rights and credits.

nodes.label: AMOTIF Vision
nodes.author: SENAI — Sistemas de Inovação e Empreendedorismo
nodes.rationale: Become the global infrastructure for music collaboration, making artist collaboration as natural and traceable as open-source software development.

nodes.label: Base Estratégica Corporativa
nodes.author: SENAI — Sistemas de Inovação e Empreendedorismo
nodes.rationale: Corporate strategy document (2025) defining the venture, vision, mission, values and SMART objectives for AMOTIF as a collaborative music platform.

nodes.label: Criterios para Extrair Services
nodes.rationale: A abordagem flat nao e dogma: extrai-se service quando a logica e compartilhada por 2+ rotas, envolve multiplas queries Prisma em uma unidade de negocio ou compromete a legibilidade da rota.

nodes.label: Sincronia Ritmica BPM + Offset
nodes.rationale: Cada musico pode gravar com seu proprio timing; BPM do projeto (sobrescrevivel por layer) e delay_offset em ms permitem calcular o posicionamento temporal exato na mixagem.

nodes.label: Paginacao Cursor-Based de Versoes
nodes.rationale: Garante performance nas listagens mesmo com muitas versoes por camada.

nodes.label: global_Error.ts (Handler Centralizado)
nodes.rationale: Elimina try/catch repetido: mapeia codigos Prisma, erros JWT, erros de validacao e erros de conexao para respostas HTTP consistentes.

nodes.label: Hooks de Autorizacao Fastify
nodes.rationale: Centralizar verificacoes de propriedade (dono do projeto, autor da layer, colaborador ativo) em hooks reutilizaveis reduz duplicacao e falhas de seguranca.

nodes.label: Versionamento de Layers
nodes.rationale: Modelo similar ao Git: cada atualizacao cria snapshot completo numerado; rollback nao deleta versoes, cria nova versao com dados da versao-alvo, preservando o historico.

nodes.label: 13 Dominios de Rotas e Schemas Espelhados
nodes.norm_label: 13 dominios de rotas e schemas espelhados
nodes.rationale: Pastas de schemas identicas as de routers tornam explicita a relacao contrato-implementacao e facilitam manutencao.

nodes.label: Upload via @fastify/multipart
nodes.rationale: Streaming direto para o storage evita carregar o arquivo inteiro em memoria; limite de 40MB e tipos MIME MP3/WAV/OGG/FLAC/AAC/M4A.

nodes.label: AJV (Another JSON Validator)
nodes.rationale: Validador JSON Schema mais rapido do ecossistema, usado nativamente pelo Fastify; compila schemas em funcoes JIT (22.527 req/s no benchmark).

nodes.label: Benchmarks Bun/Fastify/Validadores
nodes.rationale: Bun + Fastify + AJV atinge 22.527 req/s (~50% mais que Node + Fastify); Bun + Fastify + AJV fica em 4o lugar geral e top 5 configuracoes testadas. Fonte: repositorio typemarks do autor.

nodes.label: Cadeia de Validacao em 3 Camadas
nodes.rationale: TypeBox define schemas em TypeScript, gera JSON Schema, AJV compila em funcoes JIT e o Fastify executa a validacao antes dos handlers.

nodes.label: Bun Runtime
nodes.rationale: Startup em ~50ms (vs ~200ms do Node.js), ~50k req/s e ~30MB de memoria base, mantendo compatibilidade com o ecossistema Node.js.

nodes.label: POST /api/cleanup
nodes.rationale: Rota de manutencao para cron, autenticada por header x-cleanup-secret e nao por JWT; sem CLEANUP_SECRET responde 503.

nodes.label: Validacao e Criptografia de CPF
nodes.rationale: CPF criptografado com AES-256-GCM e indexado por HMAC (cpf_hash) para busca; perda da CPF_ENCRYPTION_KEY torna os CPFs ilegiveis. Justificativa: seguranca e futura protecao de direitos autorais.

nodes.label: Fastify v5
nodes.rationale: Framework mais rapido do ecossistema Node.js (~45k req/s vs ~15k do Express) com validacao nativa de schemas e performance minima.

nodes.label: Fluxo de Aprovacao de Contribuicoes
nodes.rationale: Equilibra colaboracao aberta com direcao artistica centralizada: o criador do projeto decide quais contribuicoes passam a integrar oficialmente a composicao.

nodes.label: Prisma v7
nodes.rationale: Acesso type-safe em TypeScript com migrations versionadas; trocar o provider de banco exige pouca mudanca de codigo.

nodes.label: Sessao JWT com Refresh Token Rotativo
nodes.norm_label: sessao jwt com refresh token rotativo
nodes.rationale: Access token de 4h e refresh de 7 dias rotacionado a cada uso; reapresentar token rotacionado encerra todas as sessoes do usuario (protecao contra replay).

nodes.label: Offset de Sincronizacao Temporal
nodes.rationale: Offset em milissegundos garante alinhamento perfeito entre camadas gravadas em momentos e locais diferentes.

nodes.label: Supabase Storage
nodes.rationale: O banco (Neon) guarda o link e o Supabase guarda o arquivo fisico, mantendo o custo baixo e a entrega global.

nodes.label: TypeBox
nodes.rationale: Schemas executaveis que geram tipos automaticamente e garantem type-safety em runtime (ex.: impedir texto onde se espera CPF).

nodes.label: Fluxo de Upload de Audio
nodes.rationale: Upload multipart, validacao de tamanho (40MB), streaming para o Supabase Storage e persistencia da URL na Layer via Prisma evita carregar o arquivo inteiro em memoria.

nodes.label: TypeBox, AJV, Fastify e Bun: Stack do Backend
nodes.norm_label: typebox, ajv, fastify e bun: stack do backend

nodes.label: AMOTIF
nodes.rationale: Plataforma de colaboracao musical assincrona que preenche a lacuna entre DAWs locais e plataformas genericas de compartilhamento de arquivos.

nodes.label: Reducao de Boilerplate e Indirecao
nodes.rationale: Menos arquivos e menos codigo significam desenvolvimento mais rapido, menor superficie de bugs e alteracoes localizadas em rota + schema.

nodes.label: Performance com Bun (JIT e Funcoes Puras)
nodes.norm_label: performance com bun (jit e funcoes puras)
nodes.rationale: Estrutura baseada em funcoes (rotas e hooks) e mais amigavel ao JIT do Bun; instancias de classes injetadas criam overhead desnecessario.

nodes.label: Filosofia Fastify-Native (sem MVC)
nodes.rationale: Decisao deliberada por performance maxima, baixo acoplamento e manutenibilidade: Fastify foi desenhado como grafo de plugins, entao Controllers/Services/Repositories apenas adicionariam indirecao.

nodes.label: Estrutura Flat: Rota -> Prisma
nodes.rationale: Remove as camadas Controller -> Service -> Repository -> Prisma; services que so repassam dados viram pass-through desnecessario.

nodes.label: Manutenibilidade pela Estrutura Modular
nodes.rationale: Alteracoes ficam localizadas (rota + schema), o impacto e minimo e novos desenvolvedores entendem rapidamente onde colocar um endpoint.

nodes.label: Schema-First Design (TypeBox + Fastify)
nodes.rationale: Schemas TypeBox sao a unica fonte da verdade: validam body/params/query/headers, geram tipos TypeScript e sao compilados JIT pelo Fastify, eliminando validacao manual.

nodes.label: Espelhamento de Pastas Routers/Schemas
nodes.rationale: Cada rota tem seu schema no mesmo caminho relativo; reduz impacto de mudancas e acelera onboarding.

nodes.label: Arquitetura Flat Baseada em Plugins Fastify
nodes.norm_label: arquitetura flat baseada em plugins fastify
nodes.rationale: Cada dominio e um plugin Fastify autonomo com rotas e schemas; a requisicao vai de Rota direto ao Prisma, sem Controllers/Services/Repositories, reduzindo boilerplate.

nodes.label: Git para Musicos
nodes.rationale: Inspirado em versionamento distribuido: cada contribuicao e uma camada independente que nao sobrescreve as anteriores, preservando o historico criativo.

nodes.label: Type-Safety End-to-End
nodes.rationale: Bun + Fastify + TypeBox dao tipos compartilhados, validacao em boundaries e schema unico para validacao e serializacao; validar 5 campos cai de ~30 linhas manuais para ~5.

nodes.label: AMOTIF Platform
nodes.rationale: A digital asynchronous musical collaboration platform for collective creation of musical works through structured contributions of independent instrumental layers. Unlike traditional social networks built around publishing finished content, AMOTIF acts DURING the creative process, so musicians can take part in building a song without direct contact with each other.

nodes.label: Áudio Guia (Faixa Guia)
nodes.rationale: First track (possibly just guitar and voice) that serves as the base for all other contributions aligned to the project.

nodes.label: Backend Principal (Node.js)
nodes.source_location: Page 3 — 6. Arquitetura de Fluxo de Arquivos

nodes.label: BPM (Batidas por Minuto)
nodes.rationale: The 'clock' of the song: without it the collaborator does not know at what speed to record and the music becomes a mess.

nodes.label: Camadas Instrumentais Independentes
nodes.rationale: Each contribution is registered as an independent layer that never overwrites previous contributions, preserving the creative history. Inspired by distributed versioning concepts, a song evolves progressively through multiple participations, forming a transparent creative timeline with explicit credit for each musician.

nodes.label: CPF (Validação de Usuário Real)
nodes.rationale: Security and validation that the user is real; useful if copyright protection is implemented in the future.

nodes.label: Crédito Explícito de Autoria
nodes.rationale: Each musician receives explicit credit for their participation, establishing an environment that values authorship and cooperation.

nodes.label: Delay / Offset de Alinhamento
nodes.rationale: Millisecond adjustment to guarantee the track is perfectly aligned with the base track.

nodes.label: Escala / Tom
nodes.rationale: Tells the musician which notes they may play (e.g. 'Dó Maior').

nodes.label: Fastify
nodes.rationale: The 'race car' of Node.js: much faster than Express, ideal for audio flows and heavy validations.

nodes.label: Arquitetura de Fluxo de Arquivos
nodes.rationale: Audio traffic follows an optimized path to avoid bottlenecks: business validation in Node.js, handover of the binary to the Go upload_service on port 4444, schema validation plus HTTP pipe to Supabase Storage, and finally persistence of the returned URL.
nodes.source_location: Page 3-4 — 6. Arquitetura de Fluxo de Arquivos

nodes.label: Fluxo de Colaboração (Exemplo Prático)
nodes.rationale: João creates 'Samba de Verão' at BPM 110 with a guitar track; Maria downloads it, records a flute and uploads her layer; João is notified, plays both synchronized and clicks Approve, making two official instruments.

nodes.label: Go (Fiber)
nodes.rationale: Acts as the 'heavy-load doorman': receives audio binaries with minimal latency and low memory consumption, running as a lightweight native binary without heavy VM overhead.

nodes.label: Goroutines
nodes.rationale: Low-cost concurrency: process several uploads at once with insignificant CPU and RAM usage.

nodes.label: Autenticação JWT
nodes.source_location: Page 3 — 6. Arquitetura de Fluxo de Arquivos

nodes.label: Microsserviço de Processamento de Áudio
nodes.rationale: Dedicated exclusively to heavy file traffic so AMOTIF can support multiple simultaneous uploads without compromising the main business logic.
nodes.source_location: Page 3 — 5. O Microsserviço de Processamento de Áudio

nodes.label: Neon (Banco de Dados)
nodes.source_location: Page 2-4 — Stack e Arquitetura de Fluxo

nodes.label: Pipe HTTP de Streaming para Supabase
nodes.norm_label: pipe http de streaming para supabase
nodes.rationale: Instead of loading the whole file into RAM, Go channels the audio from the user directly to Supabase Storage as the data arrives.
nodes.source_location: Page 3 — 6. Arquitetura de Fluxo de Arquivos

nodes.label: Prisma ORM
nodes.rationale: Write TypeScript and it translates to the database; if the project moves from Neon to Supabase tomorrow the code stays nearly the same.

nodes.label: Supabase Storage
nodes.rationale: Audio is heavy: the database (Neon) stores the link while Supabase stores the physical file, which is the best way to keep cost at zero.

nodes.label: Zod
nodes.rationale: Guarantees the user cannot send text where a CPF should be, or a 1GB file where the limit is 10MB.

nodes.label: Braço Curvo — Bumbo
nodes.rationale: Bottom arm; tilted cylindrical bass drum with three small notes, representing percussion and rhythm.

nodes.label: Braço Curvo — Microfone
nodes.rationale: Upper-left arm; microphone with diagonal grille lines, representing vocals and recording.

nodes.label: Braço Curvo — Teclado
nodes.rationale: Left arm; rounded keyboard body with five white and four black keys plus notes, representing keys/synths.

nodes.label: Braço Curvo — Trompete
nodes.rationale: Upper-right arm; trumpet body, bell, valves and a small white note, representing brass/horns.

nodes.label: Braço Curvo — Violão
nodes.rationale: Right arm; circular guitar body with three strings and sound hole, representing string instruments.

nodes.label: AMOTIF Brand Mark (Treble Clef with Radial Instrument Arms)
nodes.norm_label: amotif brand mark (treble clef with radial instrument arms)
nodes.rationale: A stylized green treble clef forms the spine and central rings of the mark, with five curved arms radiating out to a microphone, a trumpet, an acoustic guitar, a bass drum and a keyboard. The composition symbolizes one shared musical core fed by many different instruments/contributors — the visual statement of layered collaborative composition.

nodes.label: Clave de Sol (Treble Clef Core)
nodes.rationale: Organic clef body, upper loop, vertical stem, concentric center rings and lower tail form the hub from which every instrument arm grows.

nodes.label: AMOTIF Favicon (Raster Brand Mark)
nodes.rationale: Raster (PNG) rendition of the same mark: green treble clef hub with five instrument arms, on a white background, cropped tight for favicon/small-icon use where detailed vector strokes would be lost.

nodes.label: Paleta Verde (gradPrincipal / gradClaro)
nodes.rationale: Vertical gradient from dark forest green #2c3e2c through #6b8e4d to #8fb08f over a near-white mint background #f4f9f4: organic, calm, growth-oriented tone rather than a generic tech palette.

nodes.label: Aprovação Controlada pelo Criador do Projeto
nodes.norm_label: aprovacao controlada pelo criador do projeto
nodes.rationale: The project creator decides which contributions officially become part of the composition, balancing open collaboration with centralized artistic direction.

nodes.label: Colaboração Musical Assíncrona
nodes.rationale: Main objective of the platform is to remove geographic and logistical barriers of collaborative music production, letting artists from different places contribute to the same work in an organized, technical and safe manner.

nodes.label: measureDelaySamples
nodes.rationale: Measures the MP3 encoder/decoder offset in samples because MP3 introduces a priming delay that must be compensated for audio layers to stay aligned.

nodes.label: runChecks Verification Routine
nodes.rationale: Four checks validate the audio pipeline: onset alignment and duration for a 100 to 110 BPM time stretch, pitch preservation with tempo change, +2 semitone transposition accuracy, and post-decode MP3 delay in samples.

nodes.label: Accent Latão Token
nodes.rationale: Single extra color (#8a6a14, opaque sand-gold evoking brass instruments) used only for favorites, highlights and featured badges so tone contrast exists without drifting into rainbow-SaaS.

nodes.label: CSS File Architecture
nodes.rationale: Global.css, Navbar.css, Form.css, Login.css, Cadastro.css, Shared.css, Studio.css, User.css and Home.css keep their responsibilities unchanged; only token contents in Global.css change and glass/gradient classes are removed from Shared.css and Studio.css.

nodes.label: Three-Role Typography System
nodes.rationale: Fraunces (display) contributes organic curves matching the natural brand personality, Plus Jakarta Sans handles UI/body, and JetBrains Mono is reserved for technical audio data (BPM, delayMs, timestamps) because layer sync is measured in milliseconds. A single typeface everywhere reads as wallpaper.

nodes.label: Verde Natural Palette Tokens
nodes.rationale: The monochrome green scale (from --verde-pastel to --verde-tinta) is the brand identity and is deliberately preserved; --verde-tinta replaces the old --verde-escuro as the high-contrast title color.

nodes.label: Waveform Signature Element
nodes.rationale: The product is about audio and sync, so the visual motif was obvious but unused. The waveform replaces generic dividers as section divider, loading state, empty state and hero underline; max bar height ~24px, bar width 2-3px, gap 2px — discreet, never loose decoration.

nodes.label: AMOTIF Design System v2
nodes.rationale: Revision keeps the green-natural brand identity intact while removing patterns that read as AI-generated UI (glass everywhere, diagonal gradient on the CTA, uniform radius, generic stagger) and introduces a real signature element: the waveform.

nodes.label: AI-Generated UI Anti-patterns
nodes.rationale: Ten explicit prohibitions (no colored left borders, no CTA gradient, no shimmer, no glass outside navbar/modal, no single radius for all, no default fadeInUp stagger, no heavy black shadows, no hypersaturated colors, no more than three typefaces, no waveform as loose decoration) exist to keep the UI from regressing to template patterns.

nodes.label: Restricted Glassmorphism Scope
nodes.rationale: Glass is kept only for surfaces that float above content (navbar, modal); cards, forms, search bar, mural and collaborator list become solid white surfaces because glass applied to everything is the strongest tell of generic AI UI.

nodes.label: Meaningful Motion Set
nodes.rationale: fadeInUp with nth-child stagger applied to every card list was removed because universal stagger is decoration, not information; motion is now reserved for real layer order (layerReveal) or identity (waveformPulse).

nodes.label: Functional Border Radius Scale
nodes.rationale: Each element takes the radius of its functional category (buttons/inputs 8px, cards 14px, avatars full) instead of a pill default applied to everything; without radius hierarchy nothing looks deliberately decided.

nodes.label: Crawler Policy (robots.txt)
nodes.rationale: Crawlers may index the public marketing surface but private/authenticated areas (/home, /usuario, /studio/, /convites, /favoritos) are disallowed and a sitemap is advertised.
